items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-15
items.q: Willie Humphrey stepped in the picture then. Because he's a little clarinet player than either one of us.

ctx.x: Now I could tell him anywhere he had. Same style he played on. And then, uh, Willie Humphrey stepped in the picture then. Because he's a little clarinet player than either one of us. But he stepped in the picture after, uh, George began to travel.
And then Willie Humphrey come out.
